---
title: Environment variables
description: Gournal reads these environment variables.
---
<!-- Generated by npm run docs:gen. Do not edit. Edit descriptors in site/scripts/reference/docs-meta.ts. -->

Gournal reads these environment variables.

| Name | Default | Description |
|------|---------|-------------|
| `GOURNAL_HOME` | `.gournal` in your profile folder. On Windows, gournal uses `USERPROFILE`, then the OS home folder, and ignores `HOME`. On macOS and Linux, gournal uses `HOME`, then `USERPROFILE`, then the OS home folder. | The folder for all gournal data. |
| `GOURNAL_NO_AUTOSYNC` | Not set | Set it to `1` to turn off auto-sync. Any other value leaves auto-sync on. |
| `GOURNAL_GH` | `gh` on your `PATH` | The path of the `gh` binary. |
